answer: Not yet: Granite Bank joins our e-payoff network on March 15, 2026, so it won't be in the network for an appointment next week. Until then, you'll need to bring a payoff letter from Granite Bank showing your account number, the payoff amount, the date it is good through, and where to send payment. Ask for a 15-day payoff amount, because daily interest changes the total. If you'd rather not contact the bank yourself, you can sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request the letter for you, but allow 2 business days, so do this a few days before your appointment.
